dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular, light-toned 'O' and 'C' shaped annuli exhibit high-contrast, jagged perimeters against a dark dorsal ground; several structures show a visible gradient transition from the dark exterior pelt to a lighter-gray interior fill.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of small, solid, high-intensity light-gray pixels lacking internal gradients, primarily scattered along the mid-to-lower lateral flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Four prominent ring centroids located on the upper-mid dorsal surface form an asymmetrical, elongated quadrilateral with the longest axis oriented longitudinally toward the cephalic region.
